audit.whatIsWrong: content win[] and the packet levelChart give Maokai levels 1 through 6 (indices 0-4) and Zilean 2+ items (index 6), with First item (index 5) already Skill, but full.phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side are all still the flat 'Skill' template.
audit.why: Zilean needs two Time Bombs (10s CD rank1) stacked on one target to stun — he can't do that reliably before 6, so Twisted Advance goes through unanswered early. Chronoshift (120s CD rank1) only becomes a real answer at 6, and by 2+ items its revive plus his E kiting starts negating kills outright.
